annotations.text: Little Eileen Davies, twenty six months old, who has been named queen of the little batch of orphans that arrived from England on the Aquitania, for adoption in this country. Her head is covered with thick gold- en ringlets, while patches of rose as big as her hands spread over her cheeks. Eileen's room, at the Chapain Adoption Nursery, was the Mecca of hundreds of wealthy but heart empty New York folk, who called to adopt one or more of the orphans. This is little Aileen,who like other fellow passengers is waiting for a home and parents. 5/23/21

"The increased expenditure is the result of pressure by both sides of the House," said the Chancellor in tones of rebuke. "Then there has been a growth of expenditure on education, old age pensions, and labour exchanges. The Development Grant came to £900,000, and Ireland is responsible for an increase of £600,000 in the expenditure.

"The greatest growth of all has been in the Navy," said Mr. Lloyd-George. But although the Government had submitted estimates for £40,000,000 for the Navy, there were people who thought it ought to be more.
The Chancellor complimented the Scotch on their promptitude in paying the licence duties.
"A Scotsman and his debts are soon parted" was one of the Chancellor's proverbs. "The sooner he gets rid of his debts, the sooner he gets at the profits." (Laughter.)
A bright picture of abounding trade was then presented.

"I have made inquiry as to the trade outlook, and all the replies I have received have been most reassuring. The world's crops are likely to be abundant. There has been an enormous production of gold. The commercial world everywhere is in better heart, and there is more enterprise.

"We cannot do very much with £861,000," said Mr. Lloyd-George, turning to the disposal of the surplus.
If the revenue went up according to expectations and the expenditure did not increase too much, he hoped to make a start with a great national scheme of insurance against unemployment and invalidity.

It would (1) be a contributory scheme with a liberal State subsidy, "twice as liberal as that given by Germany"; (2) would insure two and a half million workmen employed in precarious trades and thirteen millions of workmen against distress that came from sickness and a premature breakdown of the bread-winner, and (3) set up sanitoria for working-men.

"There is no need for well-organised [=] 2019 pandemic as to British trade, British credit, and British security. The Old Country is still the soundest investment going." (Great cheering, during which the Chancellor sat down.)
